title: tc-budget-alerts
description:
Budget alerts: alert markers dragged along the month's budget bar – spent so far and the hatched forecast – with each
alert's channel and recipients and when the forecast crosses it.

spent.description: Spent so far this month, in `currency`

forecast.description: The forecast for the month's end, in `currency`; unset leaves the hatched forecast out

alerts.description: The alerts. Changed by dragging, the keys and the fields unless a tc-alerts-change listener calls preventDefault()

now.description: Now, as epoch ms; with `end` it dates the forecast's crossings

end.description: The period's last moment, as epoch ms

locale.description: The language for numbers and dates, e.g. "en-GB"; by default the browser's

timeZone.description: The time zone the crossing dates are given in, e.g. "Europe/London"; by default the browser's

at.description: Where it fires, as a share of the budget: 0.8 is 80%

recipients.description: Who it goes to: addresses, people or a chat channel
